title: Adding a marked tape cell
statement: For every finite list $m$ of natural numbers and every natural number $j$, writing true in cell $j$ of the tape whose marked cells are the nonnegative positions corresponding to members of $m$ produces the tape whose marked positions are exactly the members of the list obtained by placing $j$ at the beginning of $m$.
